original_context:
AITA for using other people’s trash cans? | My boyfriend and I have gone back and forth on this, and can’t decide, so I’m accessing the hive-mind. We are willing to accept your judgment.

Our neighborhood has no public trashcans. When we walk our dog (who is a very good girl), we always pick up her poop. But, rather than walk blocks holding a bag of poop, we’ll often put it in other people’s trash cans. original_context: AITA for insisting my children take my last name instead of fiancé’s? | I’m very proud of my last name and it’s history while he has no attachment to his other than it’s his. (His father and his side of the family aren’t good people and they are not on speaking terms). Mine is pretty generic in terms of white American society, his is unique but not in a bad way. I say that because if we were to hyphenate, it would sound terrible. He is ok with me keeping my name but he wants our future kids to have his name. Since I’m the one who carries the child, gives birth, and the one who will be the primary caregiver, I feel like I have more of a right to pass my family name down. After some back and forth he suggested going back to hyphenating because that’s what’s fair and who cares how bad it sounds. But it does sound pretty bad and we’re setting those kids up to be teased a lot if we do that. AITA for not wanting to compromise?

AITA for being upset with my wife for leaving me hanging home alone with the kids | Wife is a nurse and works long hours. I work from home so I end up taking on the bulk of the childcare.

My wife was supposed to be home at a certain time and we agreed that I would take a few hours after that to have some me time. Instead, she was over an hour late and she didn’t even contact me. Her excuse was that she was walking home and a woman was going into labor, so she stopped to help her. The lady ended up giving birth on the street. I’m not mad she stopped, but she didn’t contact me and she continued to stay with the woman even after the EMTs arrived. On top of that, even though she offered to watch the kids for longer, I missed the workout class I wanted to go to because she was late.

Am I the asshole for telling her that she should have prioritized the family and marriage? She’s very angry with me for saying so, but I feel justified given the circumstances.
